# Copilot Instructions

Follow the project instructions in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). Treat `AGENTS.md` as the source of truth for coding workflow, security expectations, project patterns, domain language, and release discipline.

For role-specific thinking, reference [docs/ai-coding-roles.md](../docs/ai-coding-roles.md). For auth, RLS, migration, deletion, import, export, or personal-data changes, reference [docs/security-checklist.md](../docs/security-checklist.md).
